common.disclaimer: KhaoSahi gives general diet and lifestyle information. It does not diagnose or treat any disease. Always follow your doctor's advice and talk to them before changing your diet or medicines.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Sorry, the app hit a problem. Your data is safe on this phone. Please try again.

language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change it later in Settings.

intro.foodBody: See which everyday Indian foods are good, which to limit and which to avoid for fatty liver and high uric acid.
intro.planBody: Small daily steps, a checklist and reminders that may help you build healthier habits.
intro.progressBody: Log your weight, waist and lab values and see them on charts. Everything stays on your phone.

disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.notMedical: KhaoSahi is a diet guide, not a medical device.

consent.title: Your data and privacy
consent.intro: Please read how KhaoSahi uses your data.
consent.whatBody: Your profile (condition, age, sex, height, weight, waist, diet, region), lab values, progress logs, your daily checklist and reminder settings.
consent.whereBody: Only on this phone. KhaoSahi has no account and no server, and we do not upload your data. If backup is on, Android's own device backup to your Google account may include app data.
consent.whyBody: To personalise your plan and to track your progress.
consent.deleteBody: Go to Settings → Delete all data. Uninstalling the app also removes it from this phone.
consent.adsBody: The app shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use your device's advertising ID. No health data is shared with ads.

ageGate.title: Are you 18 or older?
ageGate.blockedTitle: Sorry, KhaoSahi is only for adults
ageGate.blockedBody: This app is made for people aged 18 and above. For advice on healthy eating, please talk to your parents and your doctor.
